analyzer_hop_gain_help: Home cost minus buy-scope cost, per unit, buy side only: positive means the trip saves gil, negative means stay home. “needed” marks an ingredient with no home listing and no vendor.
analyzer_hop_worlds_help: Worlds other than the sell world holding the cheapest listing of an ingredient. Buy side only; sub-craft materials are not counted.
analyzer_hop_worlds_note: buy side only · sub-craft materials not counted
analyzer_scope_vs_home_help: The revenue signal read across the sell scope, minus the same signal on your sell world. A comparison, not a place to sell: retainers only list on your own world. Negative means the wider market prices lower — more sellers undercutting each other — so under the cheapest listing it is never above zero; a sale statistic can go either way. Blank when the sell scope is your sell world, and blank for a row where one of the two markets has no figure for the signal, which is most items on a seven-day window.

analyzer_cost_unpriced_title: Unpriced ingredients: {{n}} — no listing in the buy scope and no vendor; they cost 0 here
recipe_analyzer_calc_signal_semantics: Alternative columns follow the same rule per signal: ingredients take the cheapest matching listing (HQ-preferred under Require HQ) or the chosen sale statistic, revenue the cheaper of NQ and HQ on the sell world. A missing or zero statistic falls through to the listing per ingredient, never to 0; alternative revenue shows — when the sell world has no sale history.

cookie_policy_intro: This is the Cookie Policy for Ultros, accessible from
cookie_policy_what_are_cookies_body: As is common practice with almost all professional websites this site uses cookies, which are tiny files that are downloaded to your computer, to improve your experience. This page describes what information they gather, how we use it and why we sometimes need to store these cookies. We will also share how you can prevent these cookies from being stored however this may downgrade or 'break' certain elements of the sites functionality.
cookie_policy_how_we_use_body: We use cookies for a variety of reasons detailed below. Unfortunately in most cases there are no industry standard options for disabling cookies without completely disabling the functionality and features they add to this site. It is recommended that you leave on all cookies if you are not sure whether you need them or not in case they are used to provide a service that you use.
cookie_policy_disabling_body: You can prevent the setting of cookies by adjusting the settings on your browser (see your browser Help for how to do this). Be aware that disabling cookies will affect the functionality of this and many other websites that you visit. On Ultros, disabling cookies means you cannot stay logged in and the site will not remember your preferences.
cookie_policy_login_cookies_body: If you log in with Discord we set an encrypted, HTTP-only session cookie so you stay logged in as you browse. It stores your Discord access token in encrypted form and is removed when you log out.
cookie_policy_preference_cookies_body: Ultros remembers your choices in first-party cookies: interface language, home world and default price region, theme, sidebar state, crafter levels and crafting options, which changelog entries you have already seen, and whether you have hidden ads. These cookies stay in your browser and are not used for tracking.
cookie_policy_third_party_body: In some special cases we also use cookies provided by trusted third parties. The following section details which third party cookies you might encounter through this site.
cookie_policy_analytics_body: This site uses Google Analytics, which sets cookies to measure how visitors use the site — for example which pages are visited and for how long. We use this only to understand what to improve.
cookie_policy_adsense_body: The Google AdSense service we use to serve advertising uses a DoubleClick cookie to serve more relevant ads across the web and limit the number of times that a given ad is shown to you.
cookie_policy_adsense_faq: Learn more about how Google uses cookies in advertising
cookie_policy_more_info_body: Hopefully that has clarified things for you and as was previously mentioned if there is something that you aren't sure whether you need or not it's usually safer to leave cookies enabled in case it does interact with one of the features you use on our site.
cookie_policy_contact_intro: However if you are still looking for more information then you can contact us through one of our preferred contact methods:
cookie_policy_meta_description: Which cookies Ultros sets and why: your login session, preference cookies, Google Analytics, and Google AdSense advertising cookies.
privacy_policy_meta_description: How Ultros handles your data: cookies, Discord login, Google Analytics, AdSense advertising, and error reporting — explained in plain language.
privacy_policy_intro: Ultros is a free market-board companion tool for Final Fantasy XIV. This page explains what data the site handles, why, and what your choices are. We try to keep it minimal: almost everything on Ultros works without an account.
privacy_policy_auto_body: Like every website, our servers and our content delivery network (Cloudflare) process your IP address and browser information (user agent) to deliver pages and protect the site from abuse. Cloudflare also tells us which country a request came from; we use that only to pick a sensible default game region and language for you. We do not use this information to identify you or build a profile of you.
privacy_policy_cookies_body: Ultros sets first-party cookies to remember your preferences: interface language, home world and default price region, theme, sidebar state, crafter settings, and whether you have hidden ads. If you log in, one additional cookie holds your encrypted login session. None of these are used for tracking. The full list is in our cookie policy:
privacy_policy_account_body: Creating an account is optional and happens through Discord (OAuth2) using only the minimal "identify" scope. We receive your Discord user ID, username, and avatar, and we store the ID and username. Your Discord access token is kept in an encrypted, HTTP-only cookie in your browser — we never see your Discord password or email address. Logging out deletes the cookie and revokes the token with Discord.
privacy_policy_account_data_body: If you use account features, we store the data you create, linked to your Discord ID: claimed FFXIV characters and retainers, item lists (including lists you share with others), price alerts, and notification settings. If you point an alert at Discord or enable browser push notifications, we also store the delivery destination (the Discord channel or the push subscription).
privacy_policy_analytics_body: We use Google Analytics to understand which pages are used and how the site performs. Google sets its own cookies and receives usage data such as the pages you visit, your browser type, and your approximate location.
privacy_policy_google_data_link: How Google uses data from sites that use its services
privacy_policy_ads_body: Ultros shows ads through Google AdSense to cover server costs. Google and its partners use third-party advertising cookies (such as the DoubleClick cookie) to serve ads, limit how often you see the same ad, and — depending on your Google settings — personalize them. You can opt out of personalized advertising in your Google ad settings, and you can hide ads entirely on the Ultros settings page.
privacy_policy_errors_body: When the site crashes or hits a bug, an error report is sent to our error-tracking service (GlitchTip, via the Sentry SDK). Reports contain technical details: the error itself, the page URL, your browser and operating system (user agent), interface language, and guessed game region. We configure the SDK not to attach personal information such as your IP address to reports, and we use them only to find and fix bugs.
privacy_policy_market_body: Prices, listings, sale history, and retainer names shown across Ultros are public market-board data from Final Fantasy XIV, provided by Universalis. They come from the game, not from Ultros users, and are not connected to site accounts.
privacy_policy_sharing_body: We do not sell your personal data. It is shared only with the service providers named above (Cloudflare, Google, and our error-tracking service), and only as far as needed to run the site.
privacy_policy_retention_body: Account data is kept for as long as you keep your account. If you want your Discord-linked data (characters, retainers, lists, alerts) deleted, contact us and we will remove it. Preference cookies live in your browser and you can clear them at any time.
privacy_policy_contact_body: Questions, or a deletion request? Reach us on the Ultros Discord server or by email at aaron@akarras.com.

scrip_sources_help_body: Scrip Sources assumes high collectability rewards and calculates ingredient cost from market listings. Use scrip type and job filters to narrow to what you can actually turn in.
scrip_sources_efficiency_formula: cost per scrip = ingredient cost / high collectability scrip reward
scrip_sources_efficiency_details: The high reward is used as the max collectability target. Gathering and non-craftable sources are intentionally limited in this pass.
scrip_sources_assumption_lower_better: Lower cost per scrip is better
tooltip_exclude_shards: If enabled, crystal/shard/cluster ingredient costs are not counted toward the craft cost. Most crafters keep a stockpile.
tooltip_use_on_hand: Deduct ingredients you already own from the craft cost. Set per-ingredient totals on the item page.
recipe_analyzer_empty_set_levels_title: Set crafter levels to see recipe recommendations
recipe_analyzer_empty_set_levels_body: Recipe Analyzer only lists crafts your character can make. Open the crafter levels section above and enter at least one level.
recipe_analyzer_empty_job_level_zero_bod: Jobs at level 0 are skipped, so the {{job}} filter has nothing to show. Set a level above 0 in the crafter levels section above, or clear the job filter.
recipe_analyzer_empty_filters_body: Every craft was filtered out. The daily sales floor is the usual cause — pick the world you sell on above, since a world with no recent sales reports 0 sales per day for every recipe.
recipe_analyzer_calc_formula: profit = (market price − 5% tax) − cost per unit
recipe_analyzer_calc_details: Ingredient cost uses the cheapest matching listings, or the NPC vendor price when that is cheaper. Recipes that produce multiple items are costed per unit. Revenue assumes selling on your selected world and deducts the 5% market board tax. Subcraft mode checks whether crafting intermediate ingredients is cheaper than buying them directly.
recipe_analyzer_sale_stats_unavailable: Sale history is unavailable right now — prices are based on current listings.
price_basis_listing_min_help: The cheapest listing up right now. Fast to act on, easy to fake with one odd listing.
price_basis_sale_median_help: The middle price of the last 7 days of sales. The most realistic guess for a normal market.
price_basis_sale_min_help: The lowest price anything sold for in the last 7 days. Cautious.
price_basis_sale_avg_help: The average of the last 7 days of sales. Pulled up by a few expensive sales.
leve_analyzer_tool_summary: Estimate levequest value by comparing turn-in item cost against gil and expected item rewards.
leve_analyzer_tool_context: Reward item value is an estimate. Use it as a leveling shortlist, then confirm item supply before buying in bulk.
leve_analyzer_tool_help: Leve Analyzer mixes guaranteed gil rewards with expected market value from reward items. The first pass assumes baseline NQ turn-ins.
leve_analyzer_calc_formula: profit = gil reward + expected reward item value - turn-in cost
leve_analyzer_calc_details: Expected reward value depends on market prices and reward probabilities, so it is not the same as guaranteed gil.
venture_analyzer_tool_summary: Rank normal retainer ventures by gross market value and recent sales activity.
venture_analyzer_tool_context: Profit is gross revenue in this first pass; venture token cost and opportunity cost are not modeled.
venture_analyzer_tool_help: Venture Analyzer multiplies venture output quantity by current market price, then uses recent sales to help separate practical choices from slow-moving rare drops.
venture_analyzer_calc_formula: profit = output quantity * current market price
venture_analyzer_calc_details: This does not subtract venture token value or the opportunity cost of sending a retainer on another task.
vendor_resale_tool_summary_v2: Find NPC vendor items that may be worth buying as NQ items and reselling on the selected world.
vendor_resale_tool_context: HQ market listings are excluded because vendor purchases are normal quality. Specific NPC source names are not available yet.
vendor_resale_tool_help: Vendor Resale is useful for low-risk market checks where the buy price is fixed. Favor results with recent sales; high ROI on an item that rarely sells is still slow gil.
vendor_resale_calc_formula: profit = market price - vendor price - market tax
vendor_resale_calc_details: Vendor items are treated as NQ. The table compares fixed NPC cost against current market-board listings and recent sale speed.
vendor_resale_assumption_no_vendor_names: Vendor source names not shown yet
fc_crafting_tool_summary: Estimate Free Company workshop project profit from material costs and recent output sales.
fc_crafting_tool_context: Workshop outputs can have sparse sales, so pair profit with velocity before committing expensive materials.
fc_crafting_tool_help: FC Crafting Analyzer totals company craft materials at current market prices, compares that against the output item, and flags how much recent sales data supports the recommendation.
fc_crafting_calc_formula: profit = output market price - total material cost
fc_crafting_calc_details: Total cost is derived from company craft supply items, required sets, and current market-board listings for each material.
fc_crafting_assumption_market_prices: Material prices come from market listings
trends_tool_summary: Review high-velocity, rising-price, and falling-price items for the selected world.
trends_tool_context: Trends are directional signals. Open an item page before treating a movement as a buying decision.
trends_tool_help: Market Trends groups items by recent sales and price movement. High velocity is best for demand checks; rising and falling prices are prompts to investigate item history.
trends_explanation_high_velocity: Items selling frequently enough to be useful for demand and restock decisions.
trends_explanation_rising: Items whose recent price movement points upward. Treat this as a prompt to inspect supply, not a guarantee.
trends_explanation_falling: Items whose recent price movement points downward, often from oversupply or cooling demand.
